items.paragraph: 18+ month project. Ground up build of complex web based workflow application. Integrated with several 3rd party API's (Email, Text, PDF, Maps etc) Excellent ability to understand requirements and translate into build. Prompt communications and consistent updates. Expansive technical skill set. We are extremely satisfied and have awarded them another 18 month contract project.

Microrage delivered our e-commerce platform ahead of schedule and exceeded all expectations. Their team demonstrated deep technical expertise and superb attention to detail throughout the entire development lifecycle. Communication was seamless and the quality of code was outstanding.

Working with Microrage on our mobile application was an exceptional experience. They took our rough concept and transformed it into a polished, performant product that our users love. The team's proactive approach to problem-solving saved us significant time and budget.

The AI integration project Microrage completed for us has fundamentally transformed how we process data. Their understanding of machine learning pipelines and enterprise-grade software architecture is second to none. We look forward to a long-term partnership.
